private_trial_scope: Supervised explicitly selected Application on the stable integrated display, validated windowed SuperTuxKart 1.5 race and application audio, owned overlays, planned scene changes and hardware dual output. Window has a separate short C8.2 pilot and a previous-candidate C8.1 hour. Stop outputs before recovery. No physical microphone/camera, game fullscreen, remote guest, browser, live SCK reconstruction or external reception acceptance.

tests.native_identity_scope: Real owned exec/exit; injected catalog absence and birth/UID mismatches; not induced OS PID reuse or natural catalog eviction

regressions.remaining_matrix_scope: Command-level completion alone missed one internal matrix failure; the original FAIL and explicit case recheck are retained.

Application audio does not treat an absent catalog entry as death of the independently verified admitted OS process

limits: Process metrics cover Motive only, not the game/fixture/receiver.
Short/long memory observations do not prove absence of leaks.
GPU utilization includes all applications and has driver-defined interval semantics.

capture.scope: Native frame arrivals and one-second control observations. Not unique pixels/FPS or continuous health between queries.

application_identity.scope: Catalog counter includes native polls between samples. Legacy binaries lack OS identity observations.

terminal_semantics.scope: Retained terminal dispatches, not every packet in an arbitrary long session. Original classifiers and runtime failures retained.
